 "path": "programs/task-2b862c63.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # Return the zero-masked rectangle, filled from its horizontal reflection.
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 0]
    if not cells:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
    return [[grid[r][len(grid[0]) - 1 - c] for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)] for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]
"
}
